title: M3.4 Qualified Release Set implementation
purpose: Implement a deterministic PASS-only release-set layer that composes exact canonical kits with self-verifying FactoryRuns, rejects cross-kit identity collisions, and proves 100/500-package engineering scale without remote publishing.
invariants: Only self-verifying PASS FactoryRuns can enter a qualified release set.
Exact kit bytes must match FactoryRun generatedKit evidence.
Canonical Atlas validation is rerun only to trust embedded identity/digest claims; semantic review is not rerun.
One packageLineageId appears at most once per release set.
Revision ID reused with a different digest anywhere in the release set is a hard HOLD.
Release identity and ZIP bytes are independent of input order and host paths.
Release ZIP contains only release-set.json, exact kits and exact FactoryRuns.
Rollback is prior immutable release-set selection, not mutable deployment state.
Scale-100 and Scale-500 are engineering fixtures and make no semantic-quality claim.
No network, repository write, remote publication, catalog, backend, provider integration, asset contract or learner-runtime change is introduced.
requiredEvidence: Repository governance PASS and PR scope PASS.
M3.2, M3.2.5 and M3.3 regression suites remain green.
Deterministic order/path-independent release identity and ZIP.
Scale-100 deterministic build and verification PASS.
Scale-500 deterministic build and verification PASS.
Prior release remains verifiable after a newer release exists.
Static scan shows no network/repository-write/private review-context surface.
Independent contradictory QA binds one exact frozen product HEAD.
adversarialTests: Same revision ID with different digest across packages.
Synthetic scale evidence mislabeled as semantic qualification.
independentReview: Product implementation is bounded to five paths.
A later disjoint QA package must attack the frozen product head and may not repair product files.
rollback: Remove the additive release-set module, tests/workflow/readme update and work-package metadata. Promoted M3.2/M3.2.5/M3.3 and learner runtime remain unchanged.
